title: S1-016 canonical model to PROV mapping profile (declared subset)

mappings.copy_out_redacted: JSON-only redacted derivation receipt (counterparty scope in redacted_refs); no RDF triple, never silent
mappings.insert: prov:DerivedByInsertionFrom on the collection dictionary entity
mappings.remove: prov:DerivedByRemovalFrom on the collection dictionary entity (tombstone, never history edit)
mappings.withdraw: prov:wasInvalidatedBy on the membership (entity history retained)
mappings.scope: agentos:scopeTenant / agentos:scopeWorkspace / agentos:scopeGoal (extension, mandatory on every Entity)

unsupported_policy: import maps any construct outside supported_subset to an explicit UNSUPPORTED entry with its identifier; silent drops are forbidden

normalization.json: canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) over the export document
normalization.rdf: deterministic Turtle: stable IRIs only, no blank nodes in canonical output, triples sorted by (subject, predicate, object)
normalization.blank_node_policy: exporter never emits blank nodes; importer rejects documents containing blank nodes with reason blank_node
normalization.stable_ids: agentos:<ticket>/<case>/<kind>/<local-id> IRIs derived from canonical IDs only
normalization.ordering: operations ordered by (seq, op_id); membership pairs ordered by (key, member IRI)
normalization.semantic_digest: SHA-256 over the normalized supported-subset projection (redaction receipts included, redacted content excluded)

redaction.request_scope: single requesting (tenant, workspace, goal); export is computed for that scope only
redaction.foreign_entity: omitted entirely except cross-scope operations touching the requesting scope, whose foreign endpoint is a redacted reference {scope triple, redacted: true}
redaction.receipt: redaction: {mode: scope_filtered, omitted_entities: <count>} stays explainable; counts are the only foreign-scope signal
redaction.rule: no foreign content bytes, digests, object IDs, member labels or timestamps leave the export

import_rules.authority: import creates no authority and restores no content from digests (content_unrestorable flag)
import_rules.scope_binding: imported entities keep their extension scope triple; entities without a valid triple are rejected
import_rules.version_chain: supersedes references must resolve inside the imported document or a declared base; dangling references reject
